title: Interstage skill
description: Scaffold plugins/<plugin>/skills/is-<name>/SKILL.md and register it in skills.manifest.json.

plugin.description: Plugin directory under plugins/ (for example interstage or interstage-web).
plugin.x-prompt: Which plugin directory under plugins/ gets the skill?

name.description: Skill name without the is- prefix (kebab-case).
name.x-prompt: Skill name, without the is- prefix?

description.description: Trigger statement: when to use the skill (at most 1024 characters, one line).
description.x-prompt: Trigger statement (when should an agent use this skill)?

budgetBytes.description: SKILL.md size target recorded in skills.manifest.json; the validator allows 20 percent over.
